summary: Independent review of the 24-row SILAC (Lys6) FLAG-Htt IP-MS SDRF of PXD034158 (12 raw files x light/heavy) found no blocking or important issues; all values trace to PRIDE, the MCP paper (PMC9540350) or the deposited PD .msf parameters, and all controlled terms resolve in OLS.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent without producer transcript; read no earlier review-* dirs; re-fetched PRIDE record, PRIDE files/all and Europe PMC full text independently

spec_compliance.evidence: Resolved ms-proteomics 1.1.0, vertebrates 1.1.0, clinical-metadata 1.0.0 with spec/scripts/resolve_templates.py: no required column missing, no unlicensed column (genotype licensed by clinical-metadata), no mutual exclusion among the three. 24 rows x 38 columns, reserved words only where allow_not_available is true. Modification syntax NT/AC/TA/PP/MT correct (Met-loss+Acetyl with PP=Protein N-term).

source_evidence.evidence: Europe PMC PMC9540350 (title HTT-OMNI, cites PXD034158): Htt3xFlagQ20/+ and Q140/+ congenic C57BL/6J, male and female with sex-matched pairs, cortex light mixed 1:1 with 13C6-Lys whole brain of wild-type age-matched mice (CIL MT-LYSC6-MB-PK, 2 months), duplicate SILAC experiments, TCEP/chloroacetamide, trypsin FASP, 3 StageTip fractions, Q Exactive HF DDA, 4 ppm precursor, mods incl. heavy 13C6-Lys variable. PRIDE record: Q Exactive HF, SILAC, Mus musculus. .msf Sequest node 4 ppm / 0.02 Da, Label:13C(6) K dynamic (producer extract, whose embedded raw paths name these files).

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions = PXD034158) lists 84 .raw. SILAC SDRF holds the 12 20220128_*_IP_F{1,2,3}.raw, each twice (light+heavy); sibling LFQ SDRF holds 72; union = 84, overlap 0, missing 0, invented 0. No peak lists referenced.

design_consistency.evidence: 2 genotypes x 2 replicates x 3 fractions = 12 runs, 2 labels per run. Q20/Q140 and rep 1/2 match file names; fractions 1-3 from _F suffix; (source, bio rep, tech rep, fraction) and (source, assay, label) both unique. factor value[genotype] mirrors characteristics[genotype]; age constant (2 months) so not a factor.

omission_safety.evidence: Unknowns kept as reserved words (sex per replicate, heavy reference strain, fractionation chemistry SDB-RPS with no PRIDE:0000550 descendant). No invented demographics or channel maps; inferred values (adult, HCD, orbitrap) are disclosed in the manifest and implied by instrument/age.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock ... parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --sdrf_file <artifact> -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates -t clinical-metadata: exit 0 (warning only: C57BL/6J not in ncbitaxon). Per template ms-proteomics/vertebrates/clinical-metadata: each exit 0. sdrf-tools score 100/100. sdrf-tools check exit 1 on a single false positive (Met-loss+Acetyl reported hallucinated, but UNIMOD:766 label is exactly Met-loss+Acetyl in OLS).
